findings.title: DiagSpill SCTP kernel exposure
findings.description: Potentially vulnerable kernel 7.0.12-linuxkit with SCTP diagnostics reachable (sctp: loaded; sctp_diag: built-in). Local exploitation needs no capability or unprivileged user namespace; verify vendor backports. Mitigation: update the kernel, or hard-disable both sctp and sctp_diag if SCTP is unused
